# Mission AGENTS.md — High-Leverage Effect TS Adoption

Operational guidance for workers. Mission objectives live in `mission.md` and `validation-contract.md`, not here.

## Mission Boundaries (NEVER VIOLATE)

**Working tree:** Implement only in `/root/hevy-mcp-effect-ops-layer` on branch `feat/effect-ops-layer` created from `origin/main`. Do **not** commit, edit sources, or stage Changesets on `/root/hevy-mcp` (the original checkout). That checkout may already have staged `.changeset/amber-rivers-heal.md` — leave it alone.

**Ports:** This mission claims **no ports**. Do not start `wrangler dev`, `pnpm run dev`, inspect, or any long-running server. Off-limits host listeners include 22, 3080, 8006, 6767, 443, glances, netdata, pve, droid, kvm.

**External services:** None. Do not call live Hevy. Do not read or log `HEVY_API_KEY`. Deterministic tests use fake keys (`test-key`, `contract-test-key`).

**Off-limits:**

- `/root/hevy-mcp` source and its staged changeset
- Existing unrelated worktrees (`hevy-mcp-combined`, `hevy-mcp-effect-*` except this mission’s `hevy-mcp-effect-ops-layer`)
- `packages/hevy-client/src/generated/` (do not hand-edit)
- Rewriting `packages/node` stdio/HTTP/telemetry or `packages/worker` HTTP/OAuth into Effect
- Exporting Effect types from `hevy-mcp` or `@chrisdoc/hevy-cli`
- `git push` to `main`; `--no-verify`; Git in tests; creating Git identities
- Watch-mode Vitest / leftover processes

If you cannot complete work within these boundaries, return to the orchestrator. Never violate them.

## Mission Directives

**Tools:**

- `mise exec --` for all node/pnpm/npx
- Vitest via named lanes / scoped files, never raw undocumented selectors copied into docs
- `gh` only for the final PR feature (`open-github-pr`)
- GitHub MCP is allowed for PR create if `gh` cannot; prefer `gh`

**Skills:** Follow the worker skill named in the feature (`effect-client-worker`, `operations-worker`, `core-runtime-worker`, `cli-worker`). Read `architecture.md`, `validation-contract.md`, and `library/` before coding.

**Dependencies (binding):**

- `effect@^4.0.0-rc.112` (already in hevy-client, operations, core, cli)
- Effect 4 APIs: `Effect.fn`, `Stream.paginate` (not `paginateEffect`), `Cache.make` (not `cachedWithTTL`), `DateTime.now` as an Effect **value**, `Schema.TaggedError`, `Context.Service`, `Layer.succeed`, `TestClock` from `effect/testing`
- Import `Schema` from `effect`, not `@effect/schema`
- Import `effect` from a workspace package that depends on it, never from the repo root

**Other rules:**

- TDD: failing tests first, then implementation
- Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `docs:`, `chore:`)
- Git hooks stay enabled; fix hook failures
- Before every commit that touches `packages/*`: a non-empty Changeset covering the topology cascade (see `library/topology.md`)
- One Effect→Promise collapse per user invocation (MCP tool handler, resource reader, CLI command). Operations Effect programs do not `runPromise` around map/catch
- Fake API keys only
- After source changes: scoped Vitest (file-scoped first, then package/unit) + `mise exec -- pnpm --filter <pkg> run check:types`. Do not leave stale `[VAL-OPS-NNN]` prefixes on tests that no longer match the contract ID.
- Do not run full `test:pr` until the `cli-hygiene` hygiene/PR features
- Do not run two full `test:unit` lanes in parallel

## Worktree

First feature (if the worktree does not exist):

```bash
git fetch origin main
git worktree add -b feat/effect-ops-layer /root/hevy-mcp-effect-ops-layer origin/main
cd /root/hevy-mcp-effect-ops-layer
mise install
mise exec -- pnpm install
mise exec hk -- hk install --mise
```

All later features: `cd /root/hevy-mcp-effect-ops-layer` and commit there. `EndFeatureRun` `repoPath` must be `/root/hevy-mcp-effect-ops-layer`.

## Architecture reminders

- `hevy-client → operations → core`. CLI may import operations. Node/Worker must not import operations or `@hevy-mcp/hevy-client/internal`. Core must not import `/internal`.
- Public `HevyClient` stays Promise. Effect client lives on `@hevy-mcp/hevy-client/internal`.
- Effect Cache is constructed **once** in `createHevyMcpServer`, then `Layer.succeed` into request-local DI.
- Mutation quirks belong in operations, shared by tools and CLI.

## Testing & Validation Guidance

Validators: deterministic only. No agent-browser. No live Hevy.

**Milestone gate (scrutiny):** `commands.typecheck` = `mise exec -- pnpm run check:types`; `commands.test` = `mise exec -- pnpm run test:unit`. Full `check` + `test:pr` is last-milestone worker work (`release-hygiene-and-changeset`), not every scrutiny run.

**User-testing surfaces:** MCP tool/resource Vitest (`packages/core/src/tools/*.test.ts`, `packages/core/src/resources/hevy.test.ts`) and CLI (`mise exec -- pnpm run test:cli`). Max 2 concurrent validators; prefer 1 if the host is busy. Last-milestone `test:pr` is exclusive.

**Credentials:** none. Fixtures: `packages/core/test-fixtures/mock-hevy.ts`, operations in-memory `Effect.succeed`/`fail`, `packages/cli/src/test-fixtures/effect-client.ts`.

**Skip:** live lanes (`test:live`, `test:integration`, `test:worker-http:live`, `test:nightly`), `inspect`, browser.

See `library/user-testing.md`.

Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/workouts.test.ts`, `packages/operations/src/routines.test.ts`, `packages/operations/src/body-measurements.test.ts`
### VAL-OPS-010: workouts.get: entity envelope; empty body → { workout: null } without soft-404; member 404 → not_found; collection-path 404 fails
`getWorkout` returning `{ id: "w1" }` yields `{ workout: { id: "w1" } }` and descriptor `{ id: "workouts.get", safety: "read" }`. An undefined/empty workout response yields `{ workout: null }` with no `expected404Outcome`. Member GET 404 is VAL-OPS-004 `not_found`. GET 404 on `/v1/workouts` (no id) fails. Fail if empty body is flagged `not_found` or collection-path 404 is recovered.
Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/workouts.test.ts`
### VAL-OPS-011: workouts.create: Effect createWorkout with caller body; no GET/RMW; is_private not required
`workouts.create.effect({ workout })` calls Effect `createWorkout` with the caller workout body (or documented wire body) and succeeds with the created entity. It does not GET-then-PUT, does not call `buildWorkoutUpdatePayload` (that helper is update/replace only), and does not require `is_private`. Fail if create goes through the Promise client, `Effect.tryPromise`, `getWorkout`, or fails solely because `is_private` is omitted.
Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/workouts.test.ts`
### VAL-OPS-012: workouts.update: GET-then-PUT RMW via operations mutation semantics; GET 404 fails (not update success)
`workouts.update.effect({ workoutId, patch })` GETs the workout, builds the update payload via operations-owned mutation semantics, then PUTs through Effect `updateWorkout`. GET 404 during update fails the Effect (tagged not-found). Fail if it PUTs the raw patch without fetching, if GET/PUT are Promise-wrapped, or if it returns `{ workout: null, expected404Outcome: "not_found" }` as a successful update.
Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/workouts.test.ts`
### VAL-OPS-013: workouts.replaceExercises: RMW PUT with replacement array (including []) and explicit request is_private; GET 404 fails
`replaceExercises.effect({ workoutId, is_private, exercises })` GETs current, builds payload with the replacement exercise array (including `[]`, not preserved fetched exercises), sets `is_private` from the request, and PUTs. GET 404 fails the Effect. Fail if it metadata-patches only, leaves old exercises in the PUT body, drops privacy, infers `is_private` from GET, or treats GET 404 as update success.
Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/workouts.test.ts` and `packages/operations/src/mutation-semantics.test.ts`
### VAL-OPS-014: workouts.events: forwards page/pageSize/since; page>1 404 → end_of_list; page 1 404 fails; mismatch uses VAL-OPS-003
`workouts.events.effect({ page, pageSize, since })` calls Effect `getWorkoutEvents` with those params and returns `{ events, page, pageCount, since }`. Envelope normalize follows VAL-OPS-009. Soft-404 follows VAL-OPS-004. Fail if `since` is dropped, events are renamed without mapping, or page mismatch is a generic `Error`.
Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/workouts.test.ts`
### VAL-OPS-015: workouts.count: Effect getWorkoutCount; numeric workoutCount (missing → 0); does not paginate workouts
`workouts.count.effect()` calls Effect `getWorkoutCount` and succeeds with a numeric `workoutCount` (missing/undefined counts as 0). Fail if it paginates workouts to count them or uses the Promise client.
Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/workouts.test.ts`
### VAL-OPS-016: routines.get: nested routine entity (not envelope); empty → { routine: null } without soft-404; member 404 → not_found; collection-path 404 fails
`{ routine: { id: "r1", title: "Push", exercises: [] } }` yields that routine object (not the outer envelope) and descriptor `{ id: "routines.get", safety: "read" }`. `{}` yields `{ routine: null }` with no `expected404Outcome`. Member/collection 404 follow VAL-OPS-004. Fail if get-by-id recovers `/v1/routines` 404 as `not_found`.
Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/routines.test.ts`
### VAL-OPS-017: routines.create: create-mode payload quirks then Effect createRoutine; returns { routine, usesRepRanges }
Create builds the wire payload with create-mode rep_range semantics (explicit `rep_range: null` when absent; `notes` default `""`; `folder_id` included) then calls Effect `createRoutine`. Success is `{ routine, usesRepRanges }` where `usesRepRanges` is true only when a non-fixed (start !== end) range is present. Fail if it posts the raw tool input, uses update-mode omit rules, uses the Promise client, or omits the flag / sets it true for equal start/end derived reps.
Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/routines.test.ts` and `packages/operations/src/mutation-semantics.test.ts`
### VAL-OPS-018: routines.update: direct Effect updateRoutine (no RMW GET); update-mode payload quirks; { routine, usesRepRanges }
`routines.update` does **not** GET-then-PUT. It builds update-mode payload (`rep_range` omitted when absent; `notes` default `null`; no `folder_id`) and calls Effect `updateRoutine`. Success is `{ routine, usesRepRanges }` with the same flag rule as create. Fail if it sends create-mode null `rep_range` keys, includes `folder_id`, or performs a GET before PUT.
Tool: vitest
Evidence: terminal output of `packages/operations/src/routines.test.ts` and `packages/operations/src/mutation-semantics.test.ts`
### VAL-OPS-019: routines.search: Stream.paginate; case-insensitive title filter; limit default 20 max 100; stop on last/empty/missing pageCount; later-page 404 ends scan; domain result, no MCP text
`routines.search.effect({ query?, limit })` walks pages via `Stream.paginate` (Effect 4; not `Stream.paginateEffect`, `while (true)`, or `while (routines.length < limit)`). Optional `query` matches `routine.title` via case-insensitive substring; results stop at `limit` (default 20, max 100) and must not over-fetch past a satisfied limit when `pageCount` still has pages. Pagination stops when `pageCount` is missing, not a safe integer, or `pageCount <= page`, or when a page returns no items. Later-page collection 404 completes with items collected so far. Returns domain routines plus scan evidence (`pages`, `itemsScanned`) without MCP `responseContract` text. Fail if matching is case-sensitive, if it requests page 3 after a 2-page catalog, or if it imports core formatters.

Create runs operations-owned `buildMeasurementPayload` (omit `null` / `undefined`) and calls Effect `createBodyMeasurement` with `{ date, ...payload }`. Fail if explicit nulls are sent or the Promise client is used.
